_source: plone.restapi, every name="@..." registered in its configure.zcml files
_regenerate: gh api repos/plone/plone.restapi/tarball/main | tar xz && grep -rhoE 'name="@[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+"' */src/plone/restapi --include='*.zcml' | sed 's/name="//;s/"//' | sort -u
_why: The mock is the only thing our Plone adapter is tested against, so a route this file does not list is a route no real Plone answers. See mock-serves-no-invented-endpoints.test.cjs.
